versions.name: Soil and Water Conservation
versions.description: Learn how soil forms and how erosion strips it away, outline a watershed on a contour map, trace water through its cycle, and carry out a project such as planting trees or seeding bare ground.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
